questions.stem: A 36-year-old woman comes to the physician's office complaining of enlarged finger and shoe size. Her fingers and shoe size have constantly increased for the last 6 months. The patient also complains that he has a dough-like consistency in her extremities. Moreover, she is also experiencing hyperhidrosis and skin tags. The vital signs are normal. On physical examination, the jaw size looks larger than her face. Which of the following is a hallmark feature of this condition?

options.label: B
options.text: Growth of the mandible and soft tissues of the face

options.label: C
options.text: Growth of the hands and feet

options.label: D
options.text: Growth of the thorax and abdomen
